sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(9,40) for c in range(26,40) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    if not pts: return None
    # cluster by row gaps
    rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts))
    groups=[]; cur=[rs[0]]
    for r in rs[1:]:
        if r-cur[-1]<=2: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    out=[]
    for g in groups:
        gp=[p for p in pts if p[0] in g]
        out.append((min(g),max(g),min(p[1] for p in gp),max(p[1] for p in gp)))
    return out
def timer(f): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if f.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
print("start:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame))
for i in range(6):
    action(['DOWN'])
    print(f"D{i+1}:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame),last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): print("TERM"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
